name: core
description: Human-approval machinery shared by every tokenmaxxxer role. Mints a single-use approval token from an exact challenge line in the user's own turn; a role's gate finds and consumes it. Ships the canonical role-handoff contract and a deny-only board gate. Gates in this plugin refuse but never permit. No version field on purpose: for a git-distributed plugin the commit SHA is the version, so every commit is an update.
